title: SHIFT-Truck: A High-Fidelity Aerodynamics Dataset and Benchmark for Pickup Trucks
abstract: arXiv:2609.38638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pickup trucks account for 14% of new light-duty vehicles produced in the United States, yet are among the least aerodynamic. Their open cargo bed adds a flow absent from existing automotive aerodynamics datasets such as DrivAerML and SHIFT-SUV: the shear layer leaving the cab roof passes over a recirculating bed flow before separating again at the tailgate. The resulting drag lowers fuel efficiency, raises emissions and limits the range of electric trucks. Scale-resolved Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is too costly for broad design exploration; neural surrogates can predict flow features at a fraction of that cost, provided they are trained on large-scale, high-fidelity, domain-specific data. We introduce SHIFT-Truck, the first such dataset for pickup trucks. translated_title: SHIFT-Truck：一个面向皮卡车的高保真空气动力学数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 皮卡车占美国新生产的轻型车辆的14%，但其空气动力学性能却是最差的车型之一。其开放式货箱带来了一种现有汽车空气动力学数据集（如DrivAerML和SHIFT-SUV）中所缺失的流动现象：从驾驶室顶部脱离的剪切层在流经货箱内的回流流动后，才在尾门处再次分离。由此产生的阻力降低了燃油效率、增加了排放，并限制了电动皮卡的续航里程。基于尺度解析的计算流体力学（CFD）对于广泛的设计探索而言成本过高；神经代理模型能够以极低成本预测流动特征，但前提是需在大规模、高保真、特定领域的数据上进行训练。我们推出了SHIFT-Truck，这是首个此类皮卡车数据集。它包含1,000个Spalart-Allmaras延迟分离涡模拟（SA-DDES），基于一个参考皮卡几何形状在17个形状参数上进行变形得到。每个案例均在网格上运行……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文推出了首个面向皮卡车的高保真空气动力学数据集SHIFT-Truck，包含1,000个基于17个形状参数变形的皮卡几何的SA-DDES高保真模拟，填补了现有汽车空气动力学数据集中缺失的开放式货箱流动现象，为训练低成本的神经代理模型提供了领域专属数据基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SHIFT-Truck, the first high-fidelity aerodynamics dataset for pickup trucks, comprising 1,000 SA-DDES simulations of pickup geometries morphed across 17 shape parameters, capturing the open cargo bed flow absent from existing automotive datasets and enabling cost-effective neural surrogate models for pickup truck drag prediction.
